# MZ lab

> MZ lab is a solo app developer in Japan. Its app, Manga Bookcase, is a bookshelf-style manga and comic reader for Android.

## Manga Bookcase

Manga Bookcase (マンガブックケース) is a free Android app (with ads; a one-time purchase removes them) for reading manga and comics you already have as files — including books you scanned yourself (自炊). It reads from Dropbox, phone storage, or an SD card.

- Formats: folders of JPEG, PNG and WebP images; ZIP, CBZ and PDF files; RAR and CBR (optional setting). Password-protected files and copy-protected store e-books (such as Kindle books) are not supported.
- Bookshelf: each folder or file becomes one book, shown as covers or spines. Volumes of the same title are grouped. Unread tracking and search by title or author.
- Reading: right-to-left (manga), left-to-right, vertical scroll, two-page spreads. Zoom is kept when turning pages.
- Privacy: images are loaded directly to the device and are not sent to MZ lab's servers.
- Languages: Japanese and English.
- Platform: Android only (no iPhone or PC version at the moment).
